summary: Makomis Mountain's 1911 wooden lookout was replaced by a steel Aermotor in 1916, taken down in 1978, and re-erected in Speculator in 2022, where it is open to visitors.

facts.design: 40-foot steel Aermotor fire tower (NHLR gives model LL25, firetower.org gives LS25)
facts.status_note: Relocated from Makomis Mountain and re-erected in Speculator in 2022

staffing.status: not staffed; fire watch ended in 1970 or the early 1970s

access.note: Open dawn to dusk, seven days a week, free, weather permitting, per the Speculator Chamber page; confirm current hours with the village

visit.trail_note: No hike needed. The park is reached from NY Route 30 just before Speculator from the south.

events.note: Wooden fire tower built on Makomis Mountain
Steel 40-foot Aermotor replaced the wooden tower; NHLR's Built field also gives 1916
Operation ended in 1970 per firetower.org and the Speculator Chamber; Experience Our Adirondacks says the last observer left in the early 1970s
Dismantled and taken off Makomis Mountain
Excelsior Towers bought the tower from the Barber family
Re-erected and reassembled in the Village of Speculator
Chamber describes it as restored and relocated; opened to visitors September 1, 2022
Original-site record registered December 31, 2023 as US 2102

corrections.current: None relocated (Moved from Makomis to Speculator.)
corrections.proposed: relocated 2022: from Makomis Mountain to Speculator
corrections.why: The brief's entry is garbled; NHLR and firetower.org both say the tower was taken down and re-erected in Speculator in 2022.

evidence.supports: 40-foot Aermotor LL25 taken down at original site in Essex County; reassembled in Speculator in 2022
evidence.quote: The original Makomis Fire Tower, a 40-foot Aermotor LL25 model was taken down at its original location in Essex County. It was relocated and reassembled in Speculator in 2022.

evidence.supports: Speculator site administered by the village
evidence.quote: Village of Speculator

evidence.supports: NHLR location is Speculator Village Park, Essex County
evidence.quote: Speculator Village Park Essex County, New York

evidence.supports: NHLR registration date
evidence.quote: Date Registered December 31, 2023

evidence.supports: wooden tower 1911; steel 40-foot Aermotor LS25 in 1916
evidence.quote: An enclosed wooden tower was built on this site in 1911. It was replaced in 1916 by a steel 40-foot Aermotor LS25 tower.

evidence.supports: operation ended 1970; later removed by private individuals
evidence.quote: The tower ceased operation in 1970 and was subsequently removed from the summit by private individuals sometime after that.

evidence.supports: Excelsior Towers bought the pieces; re-erected in Speculator in 2022
evidence.quote: Eventually, all the pieces of the tower were purchased by Excelsior Towers and it was re-erected in the Village of Speculator in 2022

evidence.supports: erected 1911 as a wooden structure on Makomis Mountain, Essex County
evidence.quote: The Makomis fire tower was originally erected in 1911 as a wooden structure on Makomis Mountain in Essex County, NY.

evidence.supports: 1916 steel replacement, one of the first steel towers in New York
evidence.quote: Just a few years later, in 1916, the original structure was replaced, standing as one of the first steel fire towers in the State of New York.

evidence.supports: in operation until end of 1970 season; dismantled and removed in 1978
evidence.quote: The upgraded structure was in operation until the end of the 1970 fire season, and in 1978, the structure was dismantled and removed from Makomis Mountain.

evidence.supports: relocated to Sacandaga River Community Park in Speculator; open to visitors
evidence.quote: The historic Makomis fire tower has been relocated to the Sacandaga River Community Park in Speculator NY, and is now open to visitors.

evidence.supports: open dawn to dusk, seven days a week, free
evidence.quote: The tower will be open from dawn to dusk, 7 days a week, 365 days a year (weather permitting). And it's free!

evidence.supports: no hike needed to reach the tower
evidence.quote: No hike is necessary to reach the tower!

evidence.supports: park reached from Route 30 south of Speculator
evidence.quote: Access the park from Route 30, just before entering Speculator from the south, opposite the shores of Lake Pleasant.

evidence.supports: climbing gives views of Lake Pleasant
evidence.quote: Climbing the fire tower gives folks spectacular views of Lake Pleasant and the surrounding Adirondack wilderness.

evidence.supports: private ownership until 2019; restoration effort; chamber says Hamilton County
evidence.quote: The fire tower remained disassembled and in private ownership until 2019, at which time an effort was made to restore the tower in Hamilton County.

evidence.supports: chamber page links fire towers to Hamilton County
evidence.quote: Experience more fire towers in Hamilton County

evidence.supports: opened September 1, 2022 in the village of Speculator
evidence.quote: On September 1, 2022, the Makomis Mountain fire tower was opened in the village of Speculator

evidence.supports: tower stood on Makomis Mountain for 62 years
evidence.quote: For 62 years this fire tower stood tall on Makomis Mountain

evidence.supports: taken off the mountain in 1978 after closing earlier in the decade
evidence.quote: The Makomis fire tower was taken off the mountain in 1978 after closing earlier in the decade.

evidence.supports: last observer left in the early 1970s
evidence.quote: When Oscar Messenger left his post at Makomis Mountain at the end of the fire season in the early 1970s, the tower saw its last staffed fire tower observer.

evidence.supports: Excelsior Towers bought the tower from the Barber family in 2019
evidence.quote: Then, as luck would have it, Mike Vilegi of Excelsior Towers purchased the Makomis tower from the Barber family in 2019.

sources.title: Reaching New Heights in Speculator, NY

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's Built field gives 1916 for the Speculator tower; firetower.org and the Speculator Chamber say a wooden tower went up in 1911 and the steel tower replaced it in 1916. The story gives both dates.
NHLR says Aermotor LL25; firetower.org says Aermotor LS25. Not resolved from these sources.
firetower.org and the Speculator Chamber say operation ended in 1970; Experience Our Adirondacks says the last observer left in the early 1970s.
NHLR lists the Speculator site in Essex County; the Speculator Chamber page links the tower to Hamilton County. Not resolved; the story says the county is unsettled.
NHLR gives Speculator Village Park; the Speculator Chamber gives Sacandaga River Community Park.

notes_for_editor: Build and re-erection dates agree across four sources. Unresolved: end of fire watch (1970 vs early 1970s), model (LL25 vs LS25), county (Essex in NHLR, Hamilton via the chamber's link), and site name. Current access rests on a tourism page, not a village notice; confirm hours before publishing. The brief's relocation entry was garbled and is corrected.
